incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-tokens tail latency p99 breach across us-east-1. p99 = 11.8s, p95 = 2.6s, error rate +1.4%. Paging oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing alerts in the console. Linking dashboards: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/streaming-tail

alice_oncall: quick check — is this across all models or a subset?

ben_runtime: early look: seems correlated to prefixcache miss rate spike for model-family `redwood/ggml-2`. Prefetch miss rate went from ~6% to ~44% in last 10m.

carla_sre: can confirm. Cache eviction graphs show namespace `prefix-v2` has near-zero hit rate after the rollout at 4209840000.

alice_oncall: @ben can you dump prefix hash config? Suspect the new hash salt changed keys.

ben_runtime: running quick probe:
```
rbctl get config service=prefixcache namespace=prefix-v2 --fields=hash_salt,version
# output: hash_salt=0x7f9a3b v2
```
Previous salt for prefix-v1 was `0x1a4c2d` per deployment notes.

ben_runtime: I can also grep logs for prefixlookup failures.

ben_runtime: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:02:13Z] prefix_lookup miss key=abc123 namespace=prefix-v2 reason=hash-mismatch
[2026-03-15T09:02:14Z] prefix_lookup miss key=def456 namespace=prefix-v2 reason=hash-mismatch
```

alice_oncall: that matches. So the rollout changed salt and didn't warm existing caches -> massive cold misses -> downstream tail stalls on streaming since KV cache misses require recompute.

eva_custops: any customer-facing impact? I'm seeing a few support tickets for "streaming stalled" and one escalation from a large customer in eu-west.

alice_oncall: yes, potential customer impact for long-running streams. We should triage impact and mitigate.

carla_sre: mitigation options: 1) roll back prefixhash rollout (flip salt back), 2) enable compatibility layer that accepts both hash variants for a short window, 3) force cache warm by triggering bulk prefetch for hot prefixes.

ben_runtime: rollout toggle is fastest rollback. I can flip the config to `prefix-v1` salt. Will need deploy permission.

alice_oncall: do it. Post the CLI command here so audit tracks it.

ben_runtime: executing:
```
rbctl set config service=prefixcache namespace=prefix-v2 hash_salt=0x1a4c2d && rbctl rollout restart service=prefixcache
```

ben_runtime: done. Restarted prefixcache pool in us-east-1.

incident-bot: ACTION: prefixcache rollback executed by ben_runtime at 2026-03-15T09:08:02Z.

carla_sre: watching metrics. Miss rate started dropping — 44% -> 19% in 2m.

alice_oncall: p99 trending down? please post numbers.

ben_runtime: p99 now 4.3s, p95 1.4s. Still elevated vs baseline but improving.

eva_custops: I'll send a short note to the affected customer: "We're mitigating increased streaming latency due to an internal cache rollout; we rolled back and are monitoring. Will follow up once stable." Any objections?

carla_sre: go ahead. Keep wording minimal.

alice_oncall: need to triage root cause and prevent recurrence. Initial hypothesis: rollout didn't include key-compat shim and we didn't pre-warm hot prefixes. Also rollout rollout-validation smoke failed to catch high miss delta.

ben_runtime: logging shows rollout proceeded with traffic shift to v2 without prewarm. I'll create an automated canary check for prefix hit rate delta threshold before advancing.

carla_sre: also add an alert: if prefix miss-rate delta > 10% for 5m, pause rollout automatically.

alice_oncall: handoff in 10m to @dmitri_oncall-next. Dmitri, I'll summarize: rollback executed, metrics improving but still monitoring for p99 tail. Potential customer impact noted and customer notified. Investigations ongoing into rollout gating and prewarm.

dmitri_oncall-next: ack, taking over in 10. I'll be in the bridge. Please drop any remaining notes here before you leave.

ben_runtime: follow-up tasks I'm filing: - add compatibility layer PR - add prewarm job for high-qps prefixes - add canary gating + alert

carla_sre: I'll file a postmortem template and link the initial timeline.

carla_sre: timeline note: rollout start 2026-03-15T08:58:00Z, miss spike detected 09:01:30Z, rollback 09:08:02Z, p99 improved to 4.3s by 09:10.

eva_custops: copying CS ticket IDs: #5421, #5422. I'll update if customers reply.

alice_oncall: anything else? If metrics don't return to baseline in 30m, we'll escalate for a full outage postmortem.

dmitri_oncall-next: taking the bridge early. thanks all, I'll ping if I need more context. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT-4209876543 status: Mitigated (rollback done). Owners: ben_runtime, carla_sre. Monitoring until 2026-03-15T09:38:00Z.
